Calls out institutional waste, golden parachutes, and media spin in favor of real-world results.
Champions national sovereignty, fiscal discipline, and common-sense accountability for Donald Trump.
talking_points: Every time Washington politicians roll out something like Donald Trump, hardcoded D.C. bureaucrats get richer while working-class taxpayers foot the bill—we need to slash federal red tape and put America First.
Regular families balancing a kitchen-table budget look at Donald Trump and demand lower taxes, secure borders, and accountable government that stays out of our way.
